Method.name: AddRepToNcidObject
Method.Implementation: set newHddObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object).%New() set newHddObj.Rep = rep set newHddObj.Domain = domain set newHddObj.Context = context set newHddObj.Index = index Do reqObj.listOfHddNcidObj.Insert(newHddObj) // $$$TRACE("Number of requests in NcidLookupRequest: " _ reqObj.listOfHddNcidObj.Count()) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: CreateHddNcidReqObject
Method.Implementation: set reqObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.NcidLookupRequest).%New() set reqObj.listOfHddNcidObj = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() return reqObj

Method.name: AddNcidToRepObject
Method.Implementation: set newHddObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.Object).%New() set newHddObj.NCID = ncid set newHddObj.Context = context set newHddObj.Index = index Do reqObj.listOfHddRepObj.Insert(newHddObj) // $$$TRACE("Number of requests in RepLookupRequest " _ reqObj.listOfHddRepObj.Count()) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: CreateHddRepReqObject
Method.Implementation: set reqObj = ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.HDD.RepLookupRequest).%New() set reqObj.listOfHddRepObj = ##class(%ListOfObjects).%New() return reqObj
